  ref <- !is.na(band) & !is.na(p_age1) & p_age1 <= 19
  out <- rep("Unknown", length(band))
  for (w in unique(.wave)) {
    x <- band[.wave == w & ref]
    codes <- sort(unique(band[.wave == w & !is.na(band)]))
    r <- sapply(codes, function(b) mean(x < b) + mean(x == b) / 2)
    mid <- if (any(r >= 0.4 & r <= 0.6)) r >= 0.4 & r <= 0.6 else abs(r - 0.5) == min(abs(r - 0.5))
    level <- ifelse(mid, "Medium", ifelse(r < 0.4, "Low", "High"))
    hit <- .wave == w & !is.na(band)
    out[hit] <- level[match(band[hit], codes)]
  }
  out
})
